# netactuate_cloud_routing_router_vrf_interfaces (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Routing Router VRF Interfaces visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_routing_router_vrf_interfaces" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
  vrf_id    = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Cloud router ID.
- `vrf_id` (Number) VRF ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interfaces` (List of Object) Interfaces configured in the VRF. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))

<a id="nestedatt--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `ethernet_hardware_id` (String)
- `interface_id` (Number)
- `ipv4_cidr` (String)
- `ipv6_cidr` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `wireguard_port` (Number)
